releases.title: WHITE KNIGHT CAPITAL CORP. ANNOUNCES ADVANCED LIV GOLF RESTRUCTURING NEGOTIATIONS WITH PIF SOVEREIGN WEALTH FUND
releases.body:
CHEYENNE, Wyo. , Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- White Knight Capital Corp., a Wyoming corporation ("White Knight"), today announced that it is in advanced negotiations with the Public Investment Fund of Saudi Arabia ("PIF") regarding a comprehensive restructuring of LIV Golf Enterprises ("LIV Golf") and the proposed conversion of PIF's existing debt into equity.

White Knight plans to actively engage with Scott O'Neil, CEO of LIV Golf, along with his management team and advisors, to implement the proposed reorganization and launch LIV Golf 2.0 for the 2027 season, with Mr. O'Neil remaining as CEO to lead the organization.

Under the proposed terms, White Knight plans to take an assignment of PIF's rights, obligations, and claims, followed by a planned reverse merger of LIV Golf 2.0 into a Nasdaq-listed public entity. The post-merger company plans to issue equity shares to LIV Golf professional members, executive management, and new institutional investors.

As part of the proposed transaction, White Knight has requested that PIF commit an additional $100 million in direct equity investment into the public entity. All golfers currently under contract with LIV Golf would be offered updated agreements and equity participation in the Nasdaq-listed company as founding members of the restructured enterprise.

Furthermore, White Knight has arranged an additional $500 million equity facility through a major Wall Street investment bank, subject to completion of the merger and applicable conditions.

"We want to thank the PIF Sovereign Wealth Fund and Governor Yasir Al-Rumayyan for their vision, leadership, and constructive engagement," said John Rivers, Chief Executive Officer of White Knight Capital Corp. "This strategic conversion of debt to equity, combined with fresh growth capital, is intended to position LIV Golf to capitalize on the approximately $6 billion invested in building the brand. This proposed transaction would create a streamlined capital structure designed to drive sustainable profitability, positive cash flow, and long-term shareholder value."

Global Expansion Strategy

Following the proposed transaction, White Knight intends to expand LIV Golf's global footprint across key Asian and international markets. The growth strategy prioritizes securing multi-year broadcast distribution agreements, expanding global sponsorship networks, and launching branded consumer products to build high-margin revenue streams.

About John Rivers

John Rivers, Chief Executive Officer of White Knight Capital Corp., brings decades of executive leadership, financial oversight, strategic planning, and entrepreneurial experience across publicly traded companies, private enterprises, technology ventures, entertainment, and investment management. Mr. Rivers specializes in corporate restructuring initiatives, quantitative capital deployment, and scalable growth strategies.

About White Knight Capital Corp.

White Knight Capital Corp. is a private investment and management firm deploying datadriven capital across professional sports syndicates, market-making strategies, and emerging sports-technology ventures. Operating across major leagues, including the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, MLS, and professional golf, White Knight leverages proprietary quantitative models and institutional risk controls—including fractional Kelly criteria—to capitalize on structural market inefficiencies.

LOS ANGELES, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Exceptional Women Alliance (EWA) proudly announces the addition of Patti Humble, independent public company board director and former Chief Accounting Officer of UPS, to its exclusive community of high-level women executives.

Ms. Humble is a distinguished C-suite executive and audit committee financial expert with more than 30 years of global finance, transformation, and governance experience. As the former Chief Accounting Officer for UPS—a Fortune 50 enterprise—she led global controllership spanning more than 200 legal entities, SEC reporting, enterprise transformation, and multi-billion-dollar M&A integrations. Ms. Humble currently serves on the Board of Directors and Audit Committee of Ecovyst, Inc. (NYSE: ECVT), holds a global board position with the Institute of Management Accountants (IMA), and serves as Managing Director at Golden Seeds, investing in early-stage women-led enterprises.

"Patti is an extraordinary financial leader whose career represents the gold standard of governance, operational excellence, and enterprise strategy," said Larraine Segil, Founder, Chair, and CEO of EWA. "From co-leading the largest digital ERP transformation in corporate history to global oversight for a public board, her depth of expertise is phenomenal. Beyond her technical mastery, Patti's dedication to values-driven leadership and mentorship makes her a marvelous addition to our community. We are absolutely delighted to welcome her to EWA."

Throughout her career, Ms. Humble has guided organizations through complex transformation initiatives, M&A, and international operations. At UPS, she oversaw global teams of over 400 financial professionals, led process improvement teams across 50 international operations, and was a co-leader of a major digital cloud transformation. A recognized voice in corporate governance, she holds NACD Directorship Certification®, serves on the Advisory Board of the University of Iowa Tippie College of Business, and is an active member of Extraordinary Women on Boards (EWOB).

"I am honored to join the Exceptional Women Alliance and its community of accomplished, values-driven leaders. Throughout my career, I have benefited from colleagues and mentors who challenged my thinking, shared their experience and opened doors for others. I look forward to learning from this remarkable network and contributing my own experience."

About the Exceptional Women Alliance (EWA) The Exceptional Women Alliance (EWA) is an invitation-only peer mentorship organization where high-level Exceptional Women from across multiple industries are hand-selected and invested in, to grow, learn, share, and succeed. The year-long program enables each member to be connected as alumnae for life in the ever-expanding EWA global community, as their fellow women leaders continue to move into positions of significance. EWA is a values-led community that prioritizes Kindness, the Spirit of Generosity, Transparency, Gratitude, and Willingness to Share. Learn more at www.exceptionalwomenalliance.com.

TALLAHASSEE, Fla., Sept. 4, 2026 /CNW/ -- Trulieve Cannabis Corp. (NYSE: TRLV) ("Trulieve" or "the Company"), a leading and top-performing medical cannabis company in the U.S., today announced the opening of a new medical cannabis dispensary in Dunwoody, Georgia.

"This new DeKalb County dispensary expands access to medical cannabis for patients throughout Metro Atlanta," said Trulieve Chief Executive Officer Kim Rivers. "We are excited to serve the Dunwoody community and provide patients with Trulieve's high-quality products and exceptional customer experiences."

A grand opening celebration will be held Thursday, September 10, featuring a ribbon cutting ceremony at 9:30 a.m., food truck, storewide discounts, and merchandise giveaways.

Trulieve Dunwoody, located at 4675 N. Shallowford Road, Suite 100, is open 10 a.m. – 7 p.m. Sunday through Thursday, and 10 a.m. – 8 p.m. Friday and Saturday. The dispensary offers a wide selection of popular products from Trulieve's in-house brands Modern Flower, Momenta, Roll One, and Trulieve, in a variety of formats including capsules, inhalable flower, tinctures, topicals, troches, and vaporizers.

Trulieve offers several free resources on its website to help educate potential patients including its Find a Doctor tool, a free database of authorized physicians offering medical cannabis card evaluations in their area, and information on how to become a registered patient in Georgia. For more information on Trulieve's Georgia retail store locations and pharmacy partners click here and follow us on Instagram @Trulieve.GA to stay connected.

Trulieve is an industry leading, vertically integrated cannabis company and multi-state operator in the U.S., with established medical marijuana operations in Florida, Georgia, Pennsylvania, and West Virginia. Driven by a core mission to expand access to cannabis, Trulieve serves customers with innovative, high-quality branded products and exceptional experiences. releases.title: Datamaran Appoints Bert Sinnema as Chief Technology Officer
releases.body:
LONDON, NEW YORK and LEEUWARDEN, Netherlands, Sept. 4, 2026 /CNW/ -- Datamaran, the AI-powered risk and governance software provider, today announced the appointment of Bert Sinnema as Chief Technology Officer. Based out of the company's Leeuwarden office in the Netherlands, Sinnema will lead Datamaran's global engineering and product teams, including the engineering hub in Valencia, Spain, driving the technology and product vision behind the platform that helps organizations understand and manage evolving risks and opportunities.



As CTO, Sinnema will own Datamaran's product vision, strategy, and technology roadmap, from setting direction to architecture, delivery, and the teams building it. He steps into the role at a pivotal moment for the company, as Datamaran deepens its use of AI across the platform to give customers faster, more decision-ready insights into risk, regulation, and stakeholder expectations. His mandate: lead the engineering and product organization, accelerate the pace of AI-driven product development, and ensure the platform keeps pace with the increasingly complex and fast-moving risk landscape.

A track record scaling product engineering teams

Sinnema brings more than 12 years of product engineering leadership experience spanning startups, scale-ups, and category-leading platforms, with deep expertise at the intersection of engineering, cybersecurity, and AI. He joins Datamaran from Eye Security, Europe's fastest-growing cybersecurity company, where he served as VP of Engineering and built the product and engineering organization from the ground up, scaling the multi-hub international team 3x and helping the company reach a €60M Series C round.



Before Eye Security, Sinnema spent over three years at HackerOne, the world's leading ethical hacking and bug bounty platform, rising to Director of Engineering. Earlier in his career, Sinnema founded and served as CTO of SmartLockr, a secure communications and privacy platform he bootstrapped, scaled across three countries, and took through Microsoft's Ventures Accelerator in Berlin.

Building for Datamaran's next chapter



"Bert has spent his career building engineering organizations from the ground up and scaling them through some of the most demanding environments, including as a founder himself. He knows firsthand what it takes to turn conviction into something real, and to keep adapting as the market evolves," said Marjella Lecourt-Alma, CEO and co-founder of Datamaran. "As Datamaran evolves from ESG issue management into an AI-powered governance platform, Bert's founder mindset and experience building teams, technology, and culture make him exactly the right leader to shape what comes next for our teams, customers, and partners."

"I like to operate at the intersection of product engineering leadership and AI, where the hardest problems live, and the highest-leverage decisions get made," said Sinnema. "Datamaran is applying AI to help organizations navigate a genuinely complex risk landscape, and I'm excited to bring my experience building and scaling engineering and product organizations to that mission. This is the most interesting time to be building in tech, and I'm looking forward to being in the middle of it with the team."

Contact: Helen Skeen, Director of Communications and Insights: helen.skeen@datamaran.com.

releases.body:
Board of Commissioners confirms permanent leadership following a two-year interim tenure marked by record growth and expanded access to care

HOLLYWOOD, Fla., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The South Broward Hospital District Board of Commissioners has voted to name Shane Strum President and Chief Executive Officer of Memorial Healthcare System, confirming a role he has held on an interim basis since September 2024. As permanent CEO, Strum will continue to lead a system of more than 17,000 physicians and employees.

During his interim tenure, Strum has overseen the opening of two new freestanding emergency rooms in Miramar and Pembroke Pines, with a third under construction in Hollywood; the start of construction on Memorial Regional Hospital's new $670 million bed tower; new investment in robotic surgery, cardiovascular care, and imaging technology; and the launch and clinical expansion of Better Together, Memorial's collaboration with Broward Health to expand access to primary and maternal care, now growing into oncology, neurosciences, and graduate medical education across both systems. Memorial also posted the strongest financial performance in the system's 73-year history this past fiscal year.

Elizabeth Justen, Chair of the Board of Commissioners, said the board's vote reflects two years of measurable results and confidence in Strum's ability to lead Memorial into its next chapter. "Shane has delivered results our community can see and feel: new emergency rooms, a state-of-the-art bed tower now under construction, and the strongest financial performance in Memorial's history," Justen said. "He's proven he has both the vision and the discipline to lead this system, and today's vote reflects the board's full confidence in him."

Strum is a Broward County native with nearly 30 years of experience across healthcare, public service, higher education, and hospital governance.

Strum said he's honored by the board's confidence and energized by what's ahead. "I'm grateful for the trust this board and this community have placed in me," he said. "Memorial is stronger today than it's ever been, and I'm excited to keep building on that momentum, expanding access to care, growing our clinical capabilities, and taking the Better Together collaboration with Broward Health to the next level. This is just the beginning of what we can accomplish together for Broward County."

Strum, who also serves as President and CEO of Broward Health, will continue to lead both organizations. The two health systems remain separately governed, with independent boards, budgets, and operations.

Memorial's leadership team and reporting structure remain unchanged. The system will continue to operate as the South Broward Hospital District, serving its patient communities across six hospitals, including Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital.

About Memorial Healthcare System

South Florida-based Memorial Healthcare System is a national leader in quality care and patient, physician, and employee satisfaction. Its commitment to deeper caring, smarter health, and community outreach prioritizes a person-centered approach that has delivered safe, positive outcomes for more than 70 years.

Memorial is committed to healing the body, mind, and spirit of those in its care. For more information, visit mhs.net and connect on Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn.

Preston Dunlap, the first Chief Technology Officer and Chief Architect of the U.S. Space Force and U.S. Air Force, serves as a Technical Advisor to Project 777. Sean Perry, formerly with Agentic AI at Meta Superintelligence Labs, has joined as Strategic Technical Lead.

Dunlap has advised Project 777 since April 2025, providing technical perspective as the architecture and evidence base have developed.

Perry reviewed Project 777's Technical Proof Packet after leaving Meta's superintelligence organization and is now helping lead technical diligence and strategic technical engagement.

"Project 777 has now demonstrated three core breakthroughs: runtime intelligence and safety, bounded recursive self-improvement, and cross-domain operation through the same core architecture. Sean and Preston bring extraordinary perspective from frontier AI and national-security systems as we strengthen the evidence and scale what already works," said TK Stohlman, Founder & Architect of Project 777.

Project 777 is a compounding intelligence layer above frontier models and agents. Its three demonstrated breakthroughs are runtime intelligence and safety, which independently governs what may advance; bounded recursive self-improvement, which allows validated improvements to persist and compound; and cross-domain architecture, which allows the same core system to operate across materially different sectors without redesign. As agents work, built-in layers continuously check their reasoning, evidence, and safety, and can stop or redirect work before it advances. The intelligence producing the work cannot simply approve itself. This is what allows intelligence to improve and compound while the system remains under control.

Google DeepMind's recent From AGI to ASI paper identifies recursive self-improvement, new architectures, and multi-agent collective intelligence as credible pathways toward artificial superintelligence. Over the past two years, Project 777 has independently built and operated a governed architecture that brings several of those dynamics together: bounded recursive self-improvement, a model-agnostic multi-agent intelligence layer, and independent runtime control. The system carries validated intelligence, evaluation history, accepted improvements, rejected changes, and accumulated operating experience forward even as the underlying frontier models change. A2035 Ventures believes this combination represents early operating signs of safe superintelligence.

Project 777 also has early commercial validation. A2035 Ventures previously entered into an option and license agreement with Atherion Bioresearch covering up to three Project 777-generated disease programs. Aggregate potential non-royalty consideration across the programs can exceed $1 million, plus downstream royalties.

A2035 Ventures is advancing strategic discussions with major technology and frontier-AI organizations while selectively licensing Project 777-generated solutions.

A2035 Ventures is building the intelligence layer above frontier AI. Its core technology, Project 777, is a model-agnostic compounding intelligence architecture designed to make AI capability accumulate rather than reset with each model or run. Project 777 retains validated intelligence and carries that capability forward across models, runs, and materially different domains. The system has demonstrated bounded recursive self-improvement across solutions, workflows, and architecture, allowing accumulated intelligence to continue compounding even as the underlying models change. The appointments enhance the company's ability to meet the evolving needs of employers, advisors and retirement savers through industry-leading expertise and client-focused solutions.

Kevin Murphy has joined Transamerica as National Sales Manager for the Large Market, and Danny Kling has been promoted to National Sales Manager for Mid Market. Both leaders will report to Darren Zino, Head of Retirement Distribution.

These leadership appointments come as Transamerica continues to expand its retirement business, which supports more than $253 billion in retirement plan assets. Strong sales growth, particularly in pooled plans, along with increasing demand for IRA and stable value products, underscores the company's commitment to helping employers and individuals achieve better retirement outcomes through innovative solutions and industry-leading service.

"Transamerica is building on significant momentum," said Darren Zino. "We're seeing strong growth across our retirement business, and we're investing in the people who can help us keep raising the bar. Danny and Kevin are accomplished leaders with deep industry experience, and their appointments reflect our commitment to investing in the talent and leadership needed to support clients and drive our business forward. We're confident their perspectives and contributions will help us meet the needs of clients today while expanding access to retirement solutions for more Americans."

Murphy joins with more than 20 years of financial services experience spanning workplace retirement distribution, institutional sales, strategic accounts and enterprise growth. Prior to joining Transamerica, he held senior leadership roles at Broadridge, Franklin Templeton and other firms. In his new role, he will lead Large Market Distribution and help advance growth strategies, strategic partnerships and market expansion efforts.

Kling brings extensive experience driving sales growth and advisor engagement across Transamerica's retirement business. Most recently serving as Divisional Sales Manager, he has built a reputation for developing talent, coaching high-performing teams and delivering strong results for clients and partners. In his new role, Kling succeeds Brian Walker, who will retire October 1 following a distinguished career and many years of leadership within Transamerica's retirement business.

CAUTIONARY NOTE REGARDING RESULTS OF PRELIMINARY ECONOMIC ASSESSMENT

The results of the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report are preliminary in nature and are intended to provide an initial assessment of the Carangas Project's economic potential and development options. The Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report mine schedule and economic assessment includes numerous assumptions and is based on both Indicated and Inferred Mineral Resources. Inferred resources are considered too speculative geologically to have the economic considerations applied to them that would enable them to be categorized as Mineral Reserves, and there is no certainty that the preliminary economic assessments described herein will be achieved or that the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report results will be realized. The estimate of Mineral Resources may be materially affected by geology, environmental, permitting, legal, title, socio-political, marketing or other relevant issues. Bolivia has recently experienced significant social unrest, including protests and blockades that led to a government-declared state of emergency. The Company's projects have also previously been affected by illegal artisanal and small-scale mining activity, which resulted in disruption to operations. Such political and social instability could adversely affect the assumptions underlying the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report, including anticipated permitting timelines, construction schedules, and operating costs. Mineral resources are not Mineral Reserves and do not have demonstrated economic viability. Additional exploration will be required to potentially upgrade the classification of the Inferred Mineral Resources to be considered in future advanced studies.  The pit design for the deeper gold zone requires mining of waste (waste stripping) on Mining Concessions in the southern portion of the planned open pit that do not belong to the Company. These concessions include approximately 1.85% of the mineral resources that have been included in the economic analysis for the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report. These Concessions are held by the state of Bolivia and are not currently available for tenure. Although the Company is actively working with the Bolivian government to obtain them, there is no certainty that such concessions will be obtained or that a mining agreement will be entered into on acceptable terms. Failure to obtain such concessions, or to enter into a mining agreement on them could cause the Company to reevaluate the pit design and the outcome of the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report. Ausenco Engineering Canada ULC ("Ausenco") (Processing Plant, Infrastructure, Tailings, Water Management, Environment, Cost Estimate) was contracted to prepare the PEA in cooperation with SLR Canada (minerals resources), Moose Mountain Technical Services (mining), and JJ Metallurgical Services (Metallurgy). Geo., Director, Strategic Projects with Ausenco, and Mr. Marc Schulte, P.Eng., Mining Engineer with Moose Mountain Technical Services. All qualified persons for the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report have reviewed and verified the disclosure of the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report herein. The mineral resource estimate contained in the Updated Carangas PEA Technical Report is based on the Carangas MRE  with an effective date of August 25, 2023, with a re-statement on March 31, 2026. Mineral Resources are constrained by an optimized pit shell at a metal price of $41.00/oz Ag, $3,300.00/oz Au, $1.00/lb Pb, $1.30/lb Zn, $4.00/lb Cu, recovery of 81.6% Ag, 93.4% Au, 73.4% Pb, 66.9% Zn, 38.7% Cu and Cut-off grade of 30 g/t AgEq. Assumptions made to derive a cut-off grade included mining costs, processing costs, and recoveries were obtained from comparable industry situations.

TORONTO, Sept. 3, 2026 /CNW/ -- TD Bank Group ("TD" or the "Bank") today announced senior leadership appointments to strengthen key capabilities and further accelerate execution.

"We have significant momentum and even greater opportunity ahead as we drive change, power our businesses with AI, and deliver differentiated, more human, client experiences. These appointments bring critical capabilities together, strengthen accountability, and position us to move faster on the priorities that will define TD's next chapter of success," said Raymond Chun, Group President and Chief Executive Officer, TD Bank Group.

The following appointments are effective September 4, 2026.

Vlad Shpilsky is appointed Group Head, Global Technology and Solutions (GTS) and will continue to lead the GTS organization, advancing TD's technology and digital leadership across the Bank. Under his leadership, the Bank has deployed new innovations and platforms and launched new AI-enabled applications to accelerate internal operations, enhance resilience and security, elevate the client experience, and drive growth across all lines of business. 

Renu Gupta is appointed Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy and Commercial Officer and will join the Senior Executive Team. The role brings together key capabilities to help accelerate strategy, growth and execution, including Enterprise Strategy, Corporate Development, Digital Assets, Payments, Partnerships and Procurement. Gupta joined TD in 2020 after a successful career in investment banking and is currently EVP, Corporate Development and Chief Financial Officer of TD Securities.

Paul Whitehead is appointed Senior Executive Vice President, Global Corporate Services and will join the Senior Executive Team. In addition to his existing mandate, overseeing global client and colleague experience, transformation, enterprise real estate and marketing, Whitehead will assume responsibility for Global Corporate Affairs and enterprise AI. Bringing these capabilities together will help further strengthen alignment and accelerate execution across the Bank. Whitehead is a career TD banker with a track record of successful leadership across many of TD's lines of business and corporate functions.

With these changes, Taylan Turan, Group Head, Chief Operating Officer, will leave TD. Since joining the Bank, Turan has helped advance and accelerate TD's transformation agenda, strengthening how we operate, extending our AI leadership, and building capabilities that will support future growth.

"I want to thank Taylan for his partnership and leadership and wish him the very best for the future," added Chun.

About TD Bank Group

The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its subsidiaries are collectively known as TD Bank Group ("TD" or the "Bank"). TD is the sixth largest bank in North America by assets and serves 28.2 million clients in four key businesses operating in a number of locations in financial centres around the globe: Canadian Personal and Commercial Banking, including TD Canada Trust and TD Auto Finance Canada; U.S. Banking, including TD Auto Finance U.S. and TD Wealth (U.S.); Wealth Management and Insurance, including TD Wealth (Canada), TD Direct Investing and TD Insurance; and Wholesale Banking, including TD Securities and TD Cowen. TD also ranks among North America's leading digital banks, with more than 14 million active mobile users in Canada and the U.S. TD had $2.1 trillion in assets on July 31, 2026. The Toronto-Dominion Bank trades under the symbol "TD" on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange.

Veteran wealth management leader will help advisors and firms design their preferred future through values-aligned guidance.

BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OneAscent, a family of Kingdom-minded companies delivering values-aligned financial solutions to advisors and investors, today announced that Jeff Cave has joined the firm as Senior Vice President of Strategic Partnerships. 

In this newly created role, Cave will work alongside financial advisors and firms across the country to help them move into their "Preferred Future" by evaluating their businesses, identifying growth opportunities, and exploring how OneAscent's platform and business model can support their next stage of impact. Drawing on more than two decades of experience in wealth management, he will serve as a trusted partner to advisors considering affiliation, succession, independence, or strategic growth. 

Cave's approach begins with understanding each advisor's business and priorities, including where the practice is today, what matters most, and where the advisor wants to go next. That discovery is the foundation for designing their Preferred Future, and from there Cave helps advisors and firms see how OneAscent's platform, guidance, and values-aligned investment solutions can support their growth and long-term impact. 

"I've spent my career helping advisors build stronger businesses and better serve their clients," said Cave. "The wealth management industry is changing rapidly, and advisors have more choices than ever before. My goal is to help them step back, evaluate where they are today, and intentionally design where they want to go next."

Cave brings more than 25 years of leadership experience in the wealth and asset management industry. Most recently, Cave served in several roles at Eventide Asset Management, helping the firm grow distribution and assets.  Before Eventide, Mr. Cave spent over 20 years at Merrill Lynch, most recently as Director, Ultra High Net Worth Wealth Management Specialist for the Private Banking & Investment Group in New York City. He also served in SMA operations, marketing, and advisor training, helping to grow some of the industry`s most successful advisory fee-based platforms. He is also widely recognized for founding and leading the Christian Focus Group at Merrill Lynch, a nationwide network of over 1,600 advisors who seek to integrate Christian principles of finance with clients. 

Mr. Cave holds the Certified Investment Management Analyst (CIMA®) certification, administered by the Investment Management Consultants Association and taught in conjunction with the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania. He is a Certified Kingdom Advisor (CKA®) and a member of the Board of Directors for Kingdom Advisors - an organization founded by Ron Blue and Larry Burkett. He also served on the Board of Managers for the Ron Blue Institute for Financial Planning. 

"We're excited to welcome Jeff to the OneAscent team," said Rob Grubb, Chief Operating Officer at OneAscent. "His credibility, experience, and genuine passion for serving advisors make him uniquely qualified to help firms navigate today's increasingly complex landscape. Jeff's approach is centered on relationships, wisdom, and long-term impact, qualities that align perfectly with OneAscent's mission of empowering advisors to advance the Kingdom." 

"Every advisor has a preferred future," Cave added. "My passion is helping them discover it, then equipping them with the relationships, resources, and investment solutions to serve clients with excellence and make a greater impact." 

Jeff holds an MBA from the University of Minnesota and a BBA from Loyola University. Jeff and his wife live in Pennsylvania.

About OneAscent 

OneAscent is a family of Kingdom-minded companies delivering values-aligned financial solutions to advisors and investors. Guided by a mission of empowering advisors to advance the Kingdom, the firm integrates guidance, investments, and giving through financial planning, wealth management, values-aligned public and private market strategies, retirement solutions, and comprehensive resources for advisors and the families they serve. 

Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, OneAscent supports 89 advisors across 41 firms, serving stewards in 49 states and provinces with more than $7.1 billion in assets under management dedicated to building legacies and the Kingdom. Learn more at oneascent.com.

The HelloNation article explains that hospice care in Lufkin is structured to assist both patients and their loved ones. Families often face emotional strain, physical fatigue, and the daily demands of caregiving. Hospice services are designed to ease these pressures by providing skilled nursing, in-home aides, and clear guidance throughout the process.

According to the article, caregiver support is a central part of family-focused hospice. Nurses and personal care aides help with bathing, mobility, and symptom monitoring, which allows relatives to spend more quality time together. Hospice teams also provide training and education, so family members feel prepared to manage daily routines safely.

Respite care is highlighted as another important feature of hospice services in Lufkin. The article describes how temporary relief gives caregivers time to rest, attend appointments, or manage personal responsibilities. This planned break helps reduce burnout while ensuring the patient continues to receive consistent care.

Emotional support is another key component of hospice care in Lufkin. Social workers and counselors help families work through anxiety, anticipatory grief, and exhaustion. The article notes that grief support services in Lufkin begin before a loss and continue afterward, offering structured guidance during each stage of adjustment.

Bereavement programs are also discussed as part of a complete family-focused hospice approach. These programs may include counseling, support groups, and connections to community resources. Continued emotional support helps families build resilience and navigate life after hospice care.

The article emphasizes that hospice care in Angelina County addresses practical needs as well as emotional concerns. Hospice teams coordinate medical equipment, review daily routines, and help create a safe home setting. By managing logistics and care planning, hospice services provide stability during a challenging time.

Financial guidance is another area covered in the piece. The HelloNation article explains that the Medicare hospice benefit in Texas typically covers skilled nursing care, medications related to the illness, and necessary medical equipment. Hospice teams assist families in understanding the Medicare hospice benefit, completing paperwork, and clarifying coverage details.

Education and open communication are presented as essential elements of hospice care in Lufkin. Families are encouraged to ask questions and participate in shared decision-making. Clear explanations about symptom management and available hospice services help families feel informed and involved.

Spiritual guidance is also included within this family-focused hospice model. Chaplains or spiritual counselors provide support that respects individual beliefs and traditions. This care complements medical treatment and emotional support, creating a well-rounded system of care.

Throughout the article, readers learn that hospice care in Lufkin combines hospice pain management, caregiver support, grief support services, bereavement programs, and guidance about the Medicare hospice benefit into one coordinated approach. By integrating medical, emotional, and spiritual resources, hospice services help families focus on connection, comfort, and meaningful time together.

releases.title: Jon Dormo Joins FirstEnergy to Advance New Power Generation Development
releases.body:
Experienced leader will identify and develop new opportunities for power generation

AKRON, Ohio, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FirstEnergy Corp. (NYSE: FE) has named Jon Dormo its Vice President of Generation Project Development.

Reporting to Chris Beam, FirstEnergy's President of West Virginia and Maryland, Dormo will lead efforts to plan and develop new power generation projects that help meet customers' future energy needs — a critical role as electricity demand continues to grow at a rapid pace. He will work with teams across the company and with community leaders, regulators and other stakeholders to explore opportunities to build reliable, affordable sources of electricity.

Chris Beam, FirstEnergy's President of West Virginia and Maryland: "Jon brings a proven track record of leading complex energy projects and a strong commitment to safety, operational excellence and developing high-performing teams. His expertise and leadership will be invaluable as we continue advancing our generation strategy, strengthening our fleet and delivering long-term value for our customers. We are excited to welcome Jon to this important role and look forward to the impact he will make."

Jon Dormo, FirstEnergy's Vice President of Generation Project Development: "FirstEnergy is well positioned to help meet growing customer demand through strategic investments in generation resources. I look forward to working with our teams and stakeholders to develop projects that support reliability, affordability and long-term economic growth across the regions we serve."

Jon Dormo Biography

Dormo brings nearly 20 years of experience in the energy industry across engineering, construction, operations, development, project management and strategic planning. Most recently, he served as Managing Director, Projects, at American Electric Power (AEP), where he led the siting and construction of AEP's new generation capital plan while maintaining responsibility for major project safety, environmental and construction across AEP's generation fleet.

Throughout his career, Dormo has helped plan, develop and build a wide range of energy projects, including gas generation, wind and solar facilities, substations and other electric infrastructure. His experience includes evaluating project risks, supporting permitting and development activities, negotiating engineering and construction contracts, managing capital investments and collaborating with a variety of stakeholders to successfully move projects from early planning through construction and operation.

Dormo earned a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Ohio University and an MBA from Capital University. He is a licensed Professional Engineer and a certified Project Management Professional.

Maidsville Energy Center Proposal

The proposed Maidsville Energy Center reflects the type of project Dormo will help evaluate and advance as FirstEnergy plans for customers' future energy needs.

Mon Power and Potomac Edison, subsidiaries of FirstEnergy, are currently seeking approval from the Public Service Commission (PSC) of West Virginia for the project, a 1,200-megawatt combined-cycle natural gas plant near Fort Martin Power Station in Maidsville, and 70 megawatts of solar generation in Preston, Hancock and Tucker counties.

The companies expect a decision from the PSC later this year. Fort Martin and Harrison Power Station will remain in operation, in keeping with the companies Integrated Resource Plan, which outlines how Mon Power and Potomac Edison will continue delivering reliable, affordable power to customers over the next decade.

About FirstEnergy 

FirstEnergy Corp. is dedicated to integrity, safety, reliability and operational excellence. Its electric distribution companies form one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, serving more than 6 million customers in Ohio, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, West Virginia, Maryland and New York. The company's transmission subsidiaries operate approximately 24,000 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions. Follow FirstEnergy online at firstenergycorp.com and on X @FirstEnergyCorp.

releases.body:
ROUYN-NORANDA, QC, Sept. 3, 2026 /CNW/ -- BCH Collectif today announced a partnership with its sister company, Orchestro assurances et rentes collectives, and Ellipse Insurance.

This strategic merger is being welcomed with enthusiasm and optimism by all three firms. "This merger brings us closer to the type of firm we have envisioned for a long time. Together, we have the capabilities, expertise, and resources to build a specialized group insurance and employee benefits firm that exceeds employers' expectations," said Louis Lamontagne, Vice President of Operations at BCH Collectif.

The new firm will leverage its talent, technology, expertise, and vision to become a trusted business partner, distinguished by its close client relationships and modern consulting approach.

Patrice Jean, President of Ellipse Insurance, is delighted to join forces with BCH Collectif and Orchestro Group Benefits and Retirement Solutions. "The merger of our three firms enables us to create a modern new subsidiary dedicated to group insurance and employee benefits. Our current and future clients will benefit from deep expertise, user-friendly platforms, and responsive customer service." The name and brand identity of the new subsidiary will be unveiled in October.

The leadership team of the new organization will consist of Jean-Simon St-Laurent, Director of Operations at Orchestro, Jonathan Laverdière, Director of Finance at Orchestro, and Patrice Jean, President of Ellipse Insurance.

Suzanne Fortin, Founder and President of Orchestro, will continue her involvement within the organization as a partner. She will also dedicate more of her time to her role as an advisor to the organizations she supports, continuing to contribute her expertise and vision.

Clément St-Laurent, shareholder and Vice President, Business Development at Orchestro, will remain actively involved with the organization as an independent advisor. His expertise and network will continue to support business development efforts, drive the company's growth, and strengthen relationships with its partners.

Jonathan Bolduc, a Director at Orchestro and Vice President of BCH Collectif, will join the Board of Directors of the new organization. His experience and leadership will help support its growth, strengthen its governance, and guide its strategic priorities.

Jean-Simon St-Laurent is approaching this new chapter with enthusiasm: "I am embarking on this new chapter with great pride and determination alongside an exceptional team. By combining our expertise and strengths, we are creating an even stronger, more innovative organization focused on the future. We remain committed to the values that have driven our success: close relationships with our clients, excellence in service, and a truly people-centered approach."

This alliance will allow clients to maintain the trusted relationships they have built with their advisors while benefiting from an enhanced range of services. At the same time, the professionals from all three firms will be brought together within a single subsidiary, creating an even stronger and more complementary team.

About BCH Collectif

A subsidiary of Prosphère Financial Group since 2012

BCH Collectif helps organizations develop and manage financial wellness strategies, group benefit plans, and group retirement programs designed to enhance employee well-being and financial security. Through its consultative approach and its prevention, education, and awareness initiatives for employers and plan members, BCH Collectif helps organizations maximize the value of their employee benefit programs while fostering a better understanding of the financial issues related to workplace benefits.
